description: Scalar constants for the reconstructed post-battle rank-point delta; the result is cached in the battle result snapshot and applied to saved rank points by the online/ranked result path.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_RankPointCalculation; the export serializes it as "ID": "DEFAULT" under DataTable ImportKeyField Id. CalcRankPointDelta never reads the Id value or looks up a literal name: the row finder takes RowNames[0] from the first RankPointCalculationDataTables entry with rows, then FindRow for that name. Null tables are not skipped and a missing/empty set leaves the row pointer null, which the consumer dereferences.

Result_Win.simple: Base rank-point delta for a win.
Result_Win.technical: int32, constructor default 0, exported DEFAULT 23. GetWinnerTeam() maps Win_TeamA to 0, Win_TeamB to its enum value (1) and Timeover/Invalid to the 0xFF draw sentinel. After the invalid-player early return (delta 0), the consumer selects Result_Win only when the winner is not 0xFF and equals the player's team (GAISlot001). It is the base before evaluation, stock-gap, rank-gap and loss-floor steps.

Result_Lose.simple: Base rank-point delta for a loss.
Result_Lose.technical: int32, constructor default 0, exported DEFAULT -43. Selected for any non-draw winner that is not the player's team. After the other modifiers and rank-gap scaling, a non-draw loss is raised with FMath::Max to the LoseLowerLimit of the RankPointDataTable row found for the pre-battle RankPoint (GameRankPoint_FindRow checks GlobalThreshold ranges and keeps the first row encountered when no range matches); if no row is found, that floor is skipped. If any ally with a valid user-settings index has GetControlType() == 3 (AI control), the loss is then also raised to at least 0. Draws skip this branch and use the <= 0 clamp instead.

Result_Draw.simple: Base rank-point delta for a draw.
Result_Draw.technical: int32, constructor default 0, exported DEFAULT -10. Selected when GetWinnerTeam() returns the 0xFF sentinel for Timeover/Invalid. After the evaluation, stock-gap and rank-gap modifiers, the final value is clamped with FMath::Min(Points, 0); the non-draw loss-floor branch is skipped.

Evaluation_S.simple: Point adjustment for a S result evaluation.
Evaluation_S.technical: int32, constructor default 0, exported DEFAULT 10. Added to the running total when the result-rank argument (Snapshot.Key00, produced by GetResultScoreRank) is 4 (S); the switch maps 1=C, 2=B, 3=A, 4=S and unrecognised ranks add nothing.

Evaluation_A.simple: Point adjustment for a A result evaluation.
Evaluation_A.technical: int32, constructor default 0, exported DEFAULT 5. Added to the running total when the result-rank argument (Snapshot.Key00, produced by GetResultScoreRank) is 3 (A); the switch maps 1=C, 2=B, 3=A, 4=S and unrecognised ranks add nothing.

Evaluation_B.simple: Point adjustment for a B result evaluation.
Evaluation_B.technical: int32, constructor default 0, exported DEFAULT 0. Added to the running total when the result-rank argument (Snapshot.Key00, produced by GetResultScoreRank) is 2 (B); the switch maps 1=C, 2=B, 3=A, 4=S and unrecognised ranks add nothing.

Evaluation_C.simple: Point adjustment for a C result evaluation.
Evaluation_C.technical: int32, constructor default 0, exported DEFAULT -5. Added to the running total when the result-rank argument (Snapshot.Key00, produced by GetResultScoreRank) is 1 (C); the switch maps 1=C, 2=B, 3=A, 4=S and unrecognised ranks add nothing.

ForceGaugeRate.technical: int32 multiplier, constructor default 0, exported DEFAULT 2. After the result and evaluation terms, the consumer adds (GetCharacterStock(player team) - GetCharacterStock(rival team)) * ForceGaugeRate. GetCharacterStock returns the configured max for an unlimited team and 0 when no stock entry exists, so this is a stock-count difference, not a percentage or a normalized gauge value.

RankGapThreshold.simple: Rank-point gap that triggers loss mitigation.
RankGapThreshold.technical: int32, constructor default 0, exported DEFAULT 3000, in rank-point units. The consumer sums UserInfo.RankPoint from OnlineUserBattleSettings entries indexed by each character's GetCharacterIndex() (out-of-range indices are skipped; entries can include CPU users), integer-divides each team sum by its counted characters, and compares (enemy average - ally average) >= RankGapThreshold together with GetLoserTeam() == player team.

RankGapRate.simple: Multiplier applied to a mitigated loss.
RankGapRate.technical: float multiplier, constructor default 0.0f, exported DEFAULT 0.2. When the RankGapThreshold and loser-team conditions hold, the running int32 total is converted to float, multiplied by RankGapRate and cast back to int32 (truncation toward zero) before the draw clamp and the non-draw loss floor.

notes: Export: one RankPointCalculationDataTable object with RowStruct GameDataTableRow_RankPointCalculation, ImportKeyField Id, and one row DEFAULT (Win 23, Lose -43, Draw -10, S 10, A 5, B 0, C -5, ForceGaugeRate 2, RankGapThreshold 3000, RankGapRate 0.2). Numeric constructor defaults are 0/0.0f and Id's FName default is None; no other export shard or alternate copy of this table was found.

Load path: StartInitialLoading names RankPointCalculationDataTable; DTM::Tick resolves the loaded asset through the Abrams AssetManager and AddLoadedDataTables adds only non-null UDataTable pointers to RankPointCalculationDataTables (DTM+0x390).

Row selection uses the first row name of the first non-empty table, not a DEFAULT lookup; row order is significant if more rows are added. The helper does not null-check tables, and a null result is dereferenced by the consumer rather than defaulted.

Calculation order: invalid PlayerCharacter returns 0; the base result is chosen by the winner sentinel (0/1/0xFF); evaluation 1=C, 2=B, 3=A, 4=S is added; the stock difference times ForceGaugeRate is added; the optional rank-gap product truncates to int32; draws clamp to <= 0; non-draw losses apply LoseLowerLimit (when a RankPoint row is found) and then the AI-ally >= 0 floor. The result is stored as FStudioBattleResultSnapshot.Value440.

Downstream: Value440 is included in the online result KPI row and, in FBattlePvPState_Result::OnResultRecorded when IsOnlineBattleMode() and StudioOnlineMode_79C == 1, is passed to AGameManager::AddRankPoint, which clamps saved RankPoint to [0, 99999] and updates the PvPRankPointMax record for positive deltas.

status/functions.json labels calc at 0x104bdf0 and the row finder at 0x104a5f0 as behaviour-certified reconstructions with unmatched bytes, not byte-identical retail code. No retail Blueprint or live-runtime evidence was inspected, so Blueprint/editor-only uses cannot be excluded.

usages.detail: Resolves the loaded RankPointCalculationDataTable asset into the RankPointCalculationDataTables cache (DTM+0x390); null tables are filtered by AddLoadedDataTables.
BattleManager_FirstRankPointCalculationRow takes RowNames[0] from the first non-empty cached table and returns that row.
CalcRankPointDelta applies result, evaluation, team-stock and rank-gap fields in that order, then draw/loss clamps.
Stores the calculated delta in FStudioBattleResultSnapshot.Value440 for later result consumers.
Cross-table join: the pre-battle RankPoint selects a RankPointDataTable row whose LoseLowerLimit floors a non-draw loss.
Includes Snapshot.Value440 as a field in the online battle-result KPI row.
The online/ranked result path applies Snapshot.Value440 to saved rank points with AGameManager::AddRankPoint.
